newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste seen falling below FIM 90 in weak Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Neste seen falling below FIM 90 in weak Helsinki.

text.p: Finnish shares were expected to sink in depressed mood with weakness overseas amplified by a surprise loss in Neste -- which was seen falling below 90 markka from Thursday's 92.00 close, brokers said.
"I think we'll see Neste starting with eight," said one.
Neste plunged to a 26 million markka Jan-August loss before extras from a 1.14 billion markka profit. Analysts had expected profits between 123 million and 550 million markka.
However, much of the gap between forecasts and the actual was due to a surprise move by Neste to write off its entire 495 million markka downside in crude derivatives, operators noted.
"We had factored in 285 million (of which Neste had earlier warned)," one analyst said; adding that the rest of the group's performance was in line with expectations.
Huhtamaki's January-August result was largely in line with forecasts and some brokers said the group forecast of a clearly higher 1996 profit could bolster the share slightly.
Nokia was seen moving around 200 markka, possibly testing support there. Forestries and metal shares were seen tracking losses in their U.S. counterparts.
